preconditions.description: The length of the array arr must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 30 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in the array must have a length between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: All elements in the array must be strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' or (any(s in arr for s in prefixes) and len(stdout) == max(len(s) for s in arr if all(p in arr for p in prefixes)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the longest string with all its prefixes present in the array, or an empty string if no such string exists.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' or (all(p in arr for p in prefixes) and all(p in arr for p in prefixes))
postconditions.description: If the output is not empty, all prefixes of the output string must be present in the array.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' or (len(stdout) == max(len(s) for s in arr if all(p in arr for p in prefixes)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the longest string among those with all prefixes present in the array.
